title: Meeting Manetta and Bebe Ridgely, and working with Bebe
summary: Francis recently met Manetta and Ridgely; he worked with Ridgely and others.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I met Michael Moneta at a wedding Saturday.
What was it? I saw him about a month ago. I haven't seen him for about a month.
And Bebe Ridgely, I shook hands with him at Piku's funeral.

Yeah, I didn't see him. I was there at the funeral, but I didn't see him. They had a picture of him in the paper there. And he died about a month, a couple months later, too. Yeah. Did you ever work with Bebe? I guess you did. With Bebe. Bebe Ridgely?
Oh, yeah. And that tuxedo, all of them, yeah. Celestat's voice. Paul Barnes, too. Yeah. Yeah.
